messages:
eng-lead-jamie: Heads-up: scheduling a 1hr mini cutover tonight 01:30 UTC to enable orion-quant-v2 in the EU model catalog. Canary at 1% -> 10% over 30m if stable. Fallback order currently orion-quant-v1, orion-lite. Will pin v2 to 2% for top routes. @marta-sre @ryan-model please ack.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy queued: cutover job #C12345 scheduled for 1708505400 (01:30 UTC). Reply 'deploy' to kick now.
marta-sre: Ack. Telemetry hooks and dashboards are ready: /dashboards/orion-eu-canary. Canary alert rule set: p95 > 200ms OR error_rate > 0.5% -> page.
ryan-model: ACK. Artifact tag: orion-quant-v2-2026-03-21 built and smoke-tested. Model weights verified. I added quant config 8-bit-fp16 profile.
liz-oncall: Rolling change window ok from products side. Who's watching logs + regressions?
eng-lead-jamie: I'll watch latency + hallucination evals. @marta-sre you take infra; @ryan-model take model correctness.
dev-deploy-bot: deploybot: manual trigger detected -> starting canary enable. enabling orion-quant-v2 on eu routes at 1% with fallback priority [orion-quant-v1, orion-lite].
monitoring-bot: metric spike note: eu-inference-p95 increased from 110ms -> 240ms at 01:34 UTC (small sample).
marta-sre: Seeing the same. p95 for /chat-eu up, CPU on g2-shard-03 creeping. Are KV caches hitting?
ryan-model: No model-specific errors in logs. Sample outputs look ok but there's higher token generation time. Could be kernel selection preferring slower path.
eng-lead-jamie: Decision: hold canary ramp at 1%. Do not ramp. @dev-deploy-bot hold ramp.
dev-deploy-bot: ramp hold acknowledged. Canary remains at 1%.
monitoring-bot: Alert: threshold breach - p95 > 200ms sustained 3m -> page oncall.
liz-oncall: I'm on it. Investigating trace links.
marta-sre: We can try fallback reorder to promote orion-lite to second in chain and see if latency improves without full rollback. Suggest change: fallback [orion-quant-v1, orion-lite] -> [orion-lite, orion-quant-v1] for canary only.
eng-lead-jamie: Good idea. If that fails we'll rollback to v1. Approve fallback reorder for canary.
ryan-model: Approve for canary. If latency persists I'll start a quick recompile with alternative kernels.
dev-deploy-bot: apply change: canary fallback order updated -> [orion-lite, orion-quant-v1].
monitoring-bot: p95 dropping back to 130ms over 4m window.
marta-sre: Nice, p95 back in bounds. CPU normalized. Recommend keep canary at 1% for 20 more minutes, then re-evaluate for ramp.
eng-lead-jamie: Agree. Note for release notes: mention fallback reorder fix and will follow up with quant kernel patch.
eng-lead-jamie: Assigning follow-ups: @ryan-model -> kernel review; @marta-sre -> KV cache probe; @liz-oncall -> prepare rollback postmortem template.
dev-deploy-bot: canary remains at 1%. Scheduled ramp to 5% at 01:55 UTC if no regressions.
monitoring-bot: No further anomalies observed in the canary window.
eng-lead-jamie: Thanks team. I'll write a short blurb for release notes and tag in the cutover changelog.
